text: Spider-Bro webbed a robber to a wall. The robber sued him. In court, the robber cried. Emotional damage. Sticky trousers. His lawyer was Bat-Guy. He needed the money. Guilty. One million dollars. Spider-Bro couldn't pay. So now he works for the robber. As the getaway ride. Crime is up three hundred percent. The lawyers are thrilled. Who's the real villain here? Comment.
